evidence: The platinum nanoparticle dispersion and size are further explored with small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) and wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS), respectively. The chemical state and the local atomic coordination of the platinum nanoparticles are studied by X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), the former of which is revealed by the X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) and the latter by the extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS).
